historical_record.description: At the request of the Cow Hollow Improvement Club, the Recreation and Park Commission named the new playground off Baker Street, between Filbert and Greenwich, Cow Hollow Playground, to be dedicated on Saturday, March 24.

The Recreation Commission awarded the contract for improvements to Miley Playground and its field house, between Filbert, Baker and Greenwich Streets, to Elvin C. Stendell at $31,945, the lower of two bids.
The Recreation and Park Commission awarded Golden Bay Construction a $175,270 contract to renovate Cow Hollow Playground.
